summary: Busy through road on a bridge approach, signed no parking, bus zone and clearway.
reasons: Main road, no cars parked on kerb

drivers.seclusion: Houses 8-13 m away along the section, with a kindergarten and car park across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb beside a wide through lane; no pull-off, and the verge is narrow and fenced.
drivers.traffic: Busy road with the Walker Street arterial and tunnel approach next to it.
drivers.convention: No cars parked on this kerb; signs show Bus Zone, No Parking and No Stopping.

flags: Steep: 10% mean grade, 83% max near the bridge start
Signed No Parking, Bus Zone, No Stopping and Clearway
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees along the back of the footpath shade it from the south.

best_section.where: Rokeby Terrace south kerb, west of the bend past the bridge
